name: Two-Stage Training for Learnable Proposer
definition: A training procedure that divides network optimization into two stages to solve the chicken-and-egg problem where training the proposer requires a good fine network, but the fine network needs informative samples from a good proposer.
summary: Two-Stage Training for Learnable Proposer decouples proposer initialization from radiance field fine-tuning to resolve the chicken-and-egg sampling problem, ensuring stable convergence where joint training fails.
